Captain [[HENU]] was seeded as #7 out of #8, but ended up on third place,
almost reaching the Grand Final after a close semifinal vs Bps Boogeymen who was favourites to win the tournament.

The Hippos will also feature in the GetQuad Kenya tournament in January 2020.
